premise: Autumn leaves come twirling down and Hedgehog piles them up for his winter bed, but the wind huffs and puffs and blows his pile away twice; his scattered leaves bring Squirrel and Badger, they build the bed together down in a hollow, and this time the wind can't blow it away.
inspiration: The Three Little Pigs (English folk), turned gentle: the wolf is only the autumn wind, nobody is in danger, and the bed that stands is the one built low, by three friends together — the Little Red Hen's lonely work turned round too.
lesson: Hard jobs go better with friends.
learning: Hedgehogs gather dry leaves to make a cosy nest for their winter sleep.

en-US.title: Hedgehog Makes a Leaf Bed
en-US.text: {canvas:leaves 0.6} [softly] Autumn had come, and red and gold leaves came twirling down. {hedgehog:enter} Hedgehog needed a bed of dry leaves, to sleep in all winter long. {hedgehog:face happy} One leaf, two leaves, three… a lovely pile. {canvas:wind 0.8} {sfx:gust} But the wind huffed and puffed and WHOOSH! {hedgehog:face surprised} {hedgehog:spin} Off flew his bed. [gasps] Hedgehog started again. One leaf, two leaves… WHOOSH! {hedgehog:face sad} [sad] Gone again. His leaves landed on {squirrel:enter} Squirrel and {badger:enter} Badger, so {squirrel:go to hedgehog} {badger:go to hedgehog} over they came. {hedgehog:live talk} "The wind keeps taking my bed," sighed Hedgehog. {badger:live scratch-head} Badger thought. "Then make it where the wind can't reach." He {badger:live dig} dug a snug hollow, down low. Together they filled it with crackly leaves, and Squirrel {squirrel:live bury} patted them down. {sfx:crunch} Crunch, crunch. {hedgehog:face happy} In snuggled Hedgehog. The wind huffed. The wind puffed. But it couldn't blow this bed away, {canvas:wind stop} so off it went to blow somewhere else. {hedgehog:live curl hold} Hedgehog curled up, warm and prickly. [whispers] "Goodnight, Hedgehog," whispered his friends. {squirrel:face happy} {badger:face happy} {badger:hearts} {squirrel:hearts} "See you in the spring." {canvas:leaves stop}

es-ES.title: La cama de hojas de Erizo
es-ES.text: {canvas:leaves 0.6} [softly] Llegó el otoño, y las hojas caían dando vueltas, rojas y doradas. {hedgehog:enter} Erizo necesitaba una cama de hojas secas para dormir todo el invierno. {hedgehog:face happy} Una hoja, dos hojas, tres… ¡un buen montón! {canvas:wind 0.8} {sfx:gust} Pero el viento sopló y sopló y… ¡FIUUU! {hedgehog:face surprised} {hedgehog:spin} Adiós, cama. [gasps] Erizo volvió a empezar. Una hoja, dos hojas… ¡FIUUU! {hedgehog:face sad} [sad] Otra vez nada. Las hojas cayeron sobre {squirrel:enter} Ardilla y {badger:enter} Tejón, que {squirrel:go to hedgehog} {badger:go to hedgehog} vinieron a ver. {hedgehog:live talk} —El viento se me lleva la cama —suspiró Erizo. {badger:live scratch-head} Tejón se rascó la cabeza. —Pues hazla donde no llegue. Y {badger:live dig} cavó un hoyito, bien abajo. Entre los tres lo llenaron de hojas crujientes, y Ardilla {squirrel:live bury} las apretó con las patitas. {sfx:crunch} Cruj, cruj. {hedgehog:face happy} Erizo se metió dentro. Y el viento sopló y sopló, pero esta cama no se la llevó. {canvas:wind stop} Así que se fue a soplar a otra parte. {hedgehog:live curl hold} Erizo se hizo una bola calentita. [whispers] —Buenas noches, Erizo —susurraron sus amigos. {squirrel:face happy} {badger:face happy} {badger:hearts} {squirrel:hearts} —Hasta la primavera. {canvas:leaves stop}

ja-JP.title: ハリネズミくんの おふとん
ja-JP.text: {canvas:leaves 0.6}[softly]あきです。赤やきいろのはっぱが、くるくるおちてきます。{hedgehog:enter}ハリネズミくんは、ふゆじゅうねむる、はっぱのおふとんをつくりたいのです。{hedgehog:face happy}いちまい、にまい、さんまい…ふかふかのおやま。{canvas:wind 0.8}{sfx:gust}ところが、かぜがふーっ、ぷーっ、びゅうん！{hedgehog:face surprised}{hedgehog:spin}ふとんが、ふっとんだ！[gasps]もういちど。いちまい、にまい…びゅうん！{hedgehog:face sad}[sad]また、ふっとんだ。はっぱは、{squirrel:enter}リスさんと{badger:enter}アナグマくんのところへ、ひらひら。{squirrel:go to hedgehog}{badger:go to hedgehog}ふたりがやってきました。{hedgehog:live talk}「かぜが、おふとんをもっていっちゃうの」 とハリネズミくん。{badger:live scratch-head}アナグマくんは、あたまをぽりぽり。「じゃあ、かぜのとどかないところにつくろう」 そして{badger:live dig}ひくいところに、くぼみをほりました。みんなでかさかさのはっぱをいれて、リスさんが{squirrel:live bury}ぽんぽん。{sfx:crunch}かさこそ、かさこそ。{hedgehog:face happy}ハリネズミくんが、もぐりこみます。かぜがふーっ。かぜがぷーっ。でも、こんどはとびません。{canvas:wind stop}かぜは、よそへいってしまいました。{hedgehog:live curl hold}ハリネズミくんはまるくなって、ぬくぬく、ちくちく。[whispers]「おやすみ、ハリネズミくん」 とみんな。{squirrel:face happy}{badger:face happy}{badger:hearts}{squirrel:hearts}「はるに、またね」{canvas:leaves stop}

de-DE.title: Der Igel baut ein Blätterbett
de-DE.text: {canvas:leaves 0.6} [softly] Es war Herbst geworden, und rote und goldene Blätter wirbelten herab. {hedgehog:enter} Der Igel brauchte ein Bett aus trockenem Laub, um darin den ganzen Winter zu schlafen. {hedgehog:face happy} Ein Blatt, zwei Blätter, drei… ein schöner Haufen! {canvas:wind 0.8} {sfx:gust} Aber der Wind pustete und prustete, und WUSCH! {hedgehog:face surprised} {hedgehog:spin} Weg flog sein Bett. [gasps] Der Igel fing von vorne an. Ein Blatt, zwei Blätter… WUSCH! {hedgehog:face sad} [sad] Schon wieder weg. Die Blätter landeten auf {squirrel:enter} dem Eichhörnchen und {badger:enter} dem Dachs, {squirrel:go to hedgehog} {badger:go to hedgehog} und schon kamen die beiden herüber. {hedgehog:live talk} „Der Wind pustet mir immer mein Bett weg“, seufzte der Igel. {badger:live scratch-head} Der Dachs überlegte. „Dann bau es dort, wo der Wind nicht hinkommt.“ Und {badger:live dig} er grub eine kuschelige Kuhle, schön tief unten. Zusammen füllten sie die Kuhle mit raschelndem Laub, und das Eichhörnchen {squirrel:live bury} klopfte es fest. {sfx:crunch} Knister, knister. {hedgehog:face happy} Hinein kuschelte sich der Igel. Der Wind pustete. Der Wind prustete. Aber dieses Bett konnte er nicht wegpusten, {canvas:wind stop} also zog er weiter und pustete woanders. {hedgehog:live curl hold} Der Igel rollte sich zusammen, warm und stachelig. [whispers] „Gute Nacht, Igel“, flüsterten seine Freunde. {squirrel:face happy} {badger:face happy} {badger:hearts} {squirrel:hearts} „Bis zum Frühling!“ {canvas:leaves stop}

fr-FR.title: Le lit de feuilles de Hérisson
fr-FR.text: {canvas:leaves 0.6} [softly] C’était l’automne, et les feuilles rouges et dorées tombaient en tourbillonnant. {hedgehog:enter} Hérisson avait besoin d’un lit de feuilles sèches, pour dormir tout l’hiver. {hedgehog:face happy} Une feuille, deux feuilles, trois… un joli tas ! {canvas:wind 0.8} {sfx:gust} Mais le vent a soufflé, soufflé, et FOUUU ! {hedgehog:face surprised} {hedgehog:spin} Envolé, le lit ! [gasps] Hérisson a tout recommencé. Une feuille, deux feuilles… FOUUU ! {hedgehog:face sad} [sad] Envolé, encore une fois. Ses feuilles sont retombées sur {squirrel:enter} Écureuil et {badger:enter} Blaireau, alors {squirrel:go to hedgehog} {badger:go to hedgehog} ils sont venus voir. {hedgehog:live talk} « Le vent emporte toujours mon lit », a soupiré Hérisson. {badger:live scratch-head} Blaireau a réfléchi. « Alors fais-le là où le vent ne passe pas. » Et il {badger:live dig} a creusé un petit creux bien douillet, tout en bas. Ensemble, ils l’ont rempli de feuilles qui craquaient, et Écureuil {squirrel:live bury} les a bien tassées. {sfx:crunch} Cric, crac. {hedgehog:face happy} Hérisson s’est blotti dedans. Le vent a soufflé. Le vent a soufflé encore. Mais ce lit-là, impossible de l’emporter, {canvas:wind stop} alors il est parti souffler ailleurs. {hedgehog:live curl hold} Hérisson s’est roulé en boule, bien au chaud, tout piquant. [whispers] « Bonne nuit, Hérisson », ont chuchoté ses amis. {squirrel:face happy} {badger:face happy} {badger:hearts} {squirrel:hearts} « Rendez-vous au printemps. » {canvas:leaves stop}

it-IT.title: Il letto di foglie di Riccio
it-IT.text: {canvas:leaves 0.6} [softly] Era arrivato l'autunno, e le foglie rosse e dorate scendevano volteggiando. {hedgehog:enter} Riccio aveva bisogno di un letto di foglie secche, per dormire tutto l'inverno. {hedgehog:face happy} Una foglia, due foglie, tre… che bel mucchietto! {canvas:wind 0.8} {sfx:gust} Ma il vento ha soffiato, ha risoffiato e… FIUUU! {hedgehog:face surprised} {hedgehog:spin} E il letto è volato via! [gasps] Riccio ha ricominciato da capo. Una foglia, due foglie… FIUUU! {hedgehog:face sad} [sad] Sparito un'altra volta. Le foglie sono finite addosso a {squirrel:enter} Scoiattolo e a {badger:enter} Tasso, che {squirrel:go to hedgehog} {badger:go to hedgehog} sono venuti a vedere. {hedgehog:live talk} «Il vento mi porta sempre via il letto», ha sospirato Riccio. {badger:live scratch-head} Tasso ci ha pensato su. «Allora fallo dove il vento non arriva.» E {badger:live dig} ha scavato una buca riparata, bassa bassa. Insieme l'hanno riempita di foglie croccanti, e Scoiattolo {squirrel:live bury} le ha pigiate per bene. {sfx:crunch} Cric, croc. {hedgehog:face happy} Riccio si è accoccolato lì dentro. Il vento ha soffiato. Il vento ha risoffiato. Ma questo letto non è riuscito a portarlo via, {canvas:wind stop} e così è andato a soffiare da un'altra parte. {hedgehog:live curl hold} Riccio si è chiuso a palla, caldo e pungente. [whispers] «Buonanotte, Riccio», hanno sussurrato i suoi amici. {squirrel:face happy} {badger:face happy} {badger:hearts} {squirrel:hearts} «Ci vediamo in primavera.» {canvas:leaves stop}

zh-TW.title: 刺蝟的落葉床
zh-TW.text: {canvas:leaves 0.6}[softly]秋天到了，紅紅黃黃的葉子，轉呀轉，飄呀飄，落了下來。{hedgehog:enter}刺蝟需要一張乾樹葉鋪的床，才能睡一整個冬天。{hedgehog:face happy}一片葉子，兩片葉子，三片……堆成好漂亮的一堆。{canvas:wind 0.8}{sfx:gust}可是，風呼呼地吹呀吹——咻！{hedgehog:face surprised}{hedgehog:spin}床飛走了！[gasps]刺蝟重新再堆。一片葉子，兩片葉子……咻！{hedgehog:face sad}[sad]又不見了。葉子飄呀飄，落在{squirrel:enter}松鼠和{badger:enter}獾的身上，{squirrel:go to hedgehog}{badger:go to hedgehog}牠們就跑過來看。{hedgehog:live talk}「風一直把我的床吹走。」 刺蝟嘆了一口氣。{badger:live scratch-head}獾想了想：「那就做在風吹不到的地方吧。」 牠{badger:live dig}往下挖呀挖，挖出一個低低的、舒服的小窩。大家一起放進脆脆的葉子，松鼠{squirrel:live bury}把葉子拍一拍、壓一壓。{sfx:crunch}喀啦，喀啦。{hedgehog:face happy}刺蝟鑽了進去。風呼呼地吹，呼呼地吹，可是這張床，怎麼吹也吹不走。{canvas:wind stop}風只好到別的地方去吹了。{hedgehog:live curl hold}刺蝟縮成一顆暖呼呼的刺刺球。[whispers]「晚安，刺蝟。」 朋友們小小聲地說。{squirrel:face happy}{badger:face happy}{badger:hearts}{squirrel:hearts}「春天見喔。」{canvas:leaves stop}

zh-HK.title: 刺蝟的樹葉床
zh-HK.text: {canvas:leaves 0.6}[softly]秋天來了，紅色和金色的樹葉，在空中轉呀轉，慢慢飄下來。{hedgehog:enter}刺蝟要用乾樹葉鋪一張床，整個冬天都睡在裏面。{hedgehog:face happy}一片、兩片、三片……堆成軟綿綿的一大堆。{canvas:wind 0.8}{sfx:gust}可是風呼呼地吹，吹呀吹——呼！{hedgehog:face surprised}{hedgehog:spin}床飛走了！[gasps]刺蝟重新再堆。一片、兩片……呼！{hedgehog:face sad}[sad]又不見了。樹葉落在{squirrel:enter}松鼠和{badger:enter}獾身上，{squirrel:go to hedgehog}{badger:go to hedgehog}牠們便走過來看看。{hedgehog:live talk}「啲風成日吹走我張床呀。」 刺蝟歎了一口氣。{badger:live scratch-head}獾想了想。「噉就整喺風吹唔到嘅地方啦。」 牠{badger:live dig}往下掘呀掘，掘出一個低低的小窩。大家一起把脆卜卜的樹葉放進去，松鼠{squirrel:live bury}再輕輕拍實。{sfx:crunch}嚓嚓，嚓嚓。{hedgehog:face happy}刺蝟鑽了進去。風又來了，呼——呼——，吹完又吹，可是這張床，一片葉也吹不動。{canvas:wind stop}風覺得沒趣，只好到別處去吹了。{hedgehog:live curl hold}刺蝟縮成一個暖笠笠的刺球。[whispers]「早唞喇，刺蝟。」 朋友們輕聲說。{squirrel:face happy}{badger:face happy}{badger:hearts}{squirrel:hearts}「春天見喇！」{canvas:leaves stop}

gust.prompt: a sudden gust of autumn wind swirling dry leaves across grass, realistic field recording

crunch.prompt: small paws patting down a pile of dry, crunchy autumn leaves, close, realistic
